description: Free SEO check of ONE public website URL, on Kleap or not (no app_id, no usage consumed, no AI call). Reads up to 12 pages plus sitemap.xml and robots.txt and checks title, meta description, h1, canonical, viewport, lang, og:image, JSON-LD, image alt, thin content, noindex and dead internal links. Returns score.percent out of 100 (a Kleap checklist, not a Google metric), top3 fixes and every finding with its page, impact (1-10) and fix. For a Kleap site apply fixes with read_files, edit_files, publish_app, then run it again.

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.

max_pages.description: Pages to read, homepage first (default 12, max 25)
